Container.Name: domain-watchdog-worker
Container.Overview: Background worker for Domain Watchdog. Processes RDAP lookups, domain drop attempts, and async queue tasks.[br][br]Must be deployed alongside the domain-watchdog container. All connection strings must match exactly.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container | Redis container | domain-watchdog (app) container | All on the same Docker network

Config.Name: JWT Passphrase
Config.Description: Must match the JWT Passphrase set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Must match the App Secret set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: Worker Consumer Name
Config.Description: Internal messenger identifier. Leave as worker.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Must match the Database URL set in the domain-watchdog container exactly.

Config.Name: Redis Async DSN
Config.Description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

Config.Name: Redis RDAP Low DSN
Config.Description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

Config.Name: Redis RDAP High DSN
Config.Description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

Config.Name: Redis Lock DSN
Config.Description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.
